text:
Alex: heads-up — we're promoting payments-service v2.4.0 to eu-west during the 15:00-16:00 change window. There's a DB migration in the chart (migrations.enabled=true). Can we pin the chart for the migration phase to avoid image drift?
Sam: agreed. Pin the chart and the image tag. migration path is not reversible if the schema change runs concurrently.
Kai: +1. Suggest pinning chart:values and set canary=0.2 for 10 minutes then 1.0. Example helm override: `helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --set image.tag=sha256:9f8a --set migrations.enabled=true --set canary.weight=20`
Maria: who will own release notes? Need to add migration steps + rollback instructions in the notes and call out that we expect a short downtime for DB migration. I'll draft a short note.
deploy-bot: :rocket: starting canary deploy for payments-service v2.4.0 in eu-west (canary weight 20%). Job: deploy/2467. Logs: ```Starting rollout; applying 2 new replicas; running preflight hook: pre-migration-check```
Ingrid: quick question — do we have a read-only fallback for API during migration? If the canary shows higher 5xx, we should flip to read-only and stop the migration.
Sam: yes we have read-only flag behind feature-flag service-toggle. If >3% 5xx over 2 minutes, we flip to read-only and pin previous chart.
Alex: I'll monitor traces + errors. Sam, can you prepare the rollback pin command?
Sam: using chart museum: `helm rollback payments 3 --namespace=payments-system` won't be safe because the DB will be migrated. We'll instead pin the previous chart by setting `app.kubernetes.io/version=2.3.8` on the deployment and pause migrations: `kubectl -n payments patch deploy payments --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"release-pin":"2.3.8"}}}}}'`
Kai: also prepare a quick smoke test: `kubectl -n payments exec deploy/payments-canary -- curl -sS -f http://localhost:8080/healthz` — if that fails, revert traffic and hold.
deploy-bot: :warning: canary health check failing after 7m — replicas 1/2 ready, readiness probe failing on /migrate/health. Error: migration lock timeout. Suggested action: pause canary, escalate to oncall.
Alex: pausing canary now. Rolling pin to 2.3.8 per Sam's patch. Maria, stop publishing release notes until we confirm next steps.
Maria: acknowledged; I'll add a note: "Promotion paused — migration lock hit; rollback pin applied; follow-up after postmortem."
Ingrid: filing a quick incident ticket and tagging DB eng. If migration lock is due to concurrent job, we should prevent auto-retries.
Sam: I'll run a safe manual fallback: `kubectl -n payments scale deploy payments --replicas=0 && kubectl -n payments apply -f pinned-deploy-2.3.8.yaml && kubectl -n payments scale deploy payments --replicas=3` then confirm no schema write attempts.
Alex: good. Thanks everyone. After DB team investigates we'll decide rollforward vs full rollback. Leaving thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
